title: Unary internal Hom derives to internal RHom from a degree-zero module
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $T_M=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(M,-)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom], assumed additive. Let $S:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] with comparison $\delta:T_M^{\bullet}Q\to QS$ be a right derived functor of termwise internal Hom, for quasi-isomorphisms. Then $S$ is naturally isomorphic to $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(M[0],-)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. No local freeness, algebra structure, or adjunction is assumed.

proof.text: Use the source-library functorial K-injective replacement I and augmentation η. Termwise additive internal Hom preserves homotopy equivalences, so the K-injective localizer derives termwise Hom followed by Q. Mathlib Derives.isIso_of_isRightDerivedFunctor makes δ invertible on I(K). Q inverts η, yielding a natural isomorphism Q⋙S ≅ I⋙T_M^bullet⋙Q.

Specialize derivedInternalHom_comparison at M[0]. Use curryObjProdComp and curry.mapIso to express it as an isomorphism from Q precomposed with the desired specialization to I followed by the single-source Hom-complex functor and Q. Compose with the natural chain comparison of lem-sc-hom-complex-single-natural.
Compose the first comparison with the inverse of the second. Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft Q and preimageIso descend the resulting natural isomorphism to S ≅ RHom(M[0],-).

proof_origin.place: Y2 proof: K-injective computation of δ, specialization of derivedInternalHom_comparison, and fully faithful localization descent; follows original source construction.
